title: Von Däniken's ancient astronaut reading of the Nazca Lines

tellings.quote: Erich von Däniken, author of Chariots of the Gods, thought that they were tributes to ancient alien astronauts and extraterrestrial group that seeded human civilization.

plain: The Nazca Lines, huge figures marked into the ground in Peru, were tributes to ancient alien astronauts in the view of Erich von Däniken, author of the book Chariots of the Gods. He believed these were an extraterrestrial group that seeded human civilization. Michels sums up this view himself in an episode about strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru.
